summary: Mergeable PR with minor maintainability issue. The change is functional, minimal, and follows project conventions, but could benefit from a docstring update.

issues.description: The added method could benefit from a docstring explaining its purpose and usage.
No tests are added to verify the functionality of the new method, although the automated tests already pass.
The code formatting is consistent with the project conventions, but the added method could be formatted to match the surrounding code more closely.
